name: fundraising-os
description: 13 Claude skills that run a startup raise as a system — starting with whether and when to raise at all. Team-aware decision engine, target list, warm intros, deck, model, personalised outreach, pipeline, data room, investor warmth, and the close, paced by a chief-of-staff skill. A Human-Assisted Autonomous Organization (HAAO) for fundraising, by Ludovic Bodin.
